configuration_rationale: Extend matched coverage to unchanged existing Q2 predicate-count query on a new verified SF1 clone. Preserve all feature/snapshot/result/row/task gates; no slowed SQL, load generation, inferred intensity, file growth or fake measurements. First refresh the actual client catalog state and record new current snapshot/file-inventory statements just before maintenance, require original state unchanged, bind them and the explicit pre-action windows to the actual maintenance UUID. Metadata age at actual RPC must be at most the declared two seconds, same operational freshness scale as the observer; no stale warmup-time inventory substituted for action state. Short query may miss exposure; preserve/refuse that result. One episode, not variance, causal benefit, trained costs or scheduling acceptance. Atomic binpack/polling/06:15 IST cutoff unchanged.

telemetry.rationale: One-second real host counter cadence, five-minute warmup plus five-second margin; retain existing 95% coverage and two-second gap/freshness gates. Exact bounds/available frontier and actual submission freshness are independently checked. No normalized demand assumed.
